weight_definition: Every source row contributes its count-column value to weighted numerators and denominators.
count_interpretation: The project plan describes count as the number of decisions represented by an aggregate row; the prepared local Parquet has a non-null Int64 count column.
distance_metric: Root mean squared Euclidean distance over features known for both profiles; average linkage of profile-pair distances.
distance_threshold_note: The threshold is supplied by the analyst; inspect merge heights and sensitivity before interpreting cluster assignments.
unknown_handling: UNKNOWN weight is reported separately; shares use known weighted count (TRUE + FALSE) as the denominator. Pairwise clustering distances use only features with known shares for both profiles; profiles with no known feature shares are excluded.
confidence_intervals: Wilson 95% intervals are reported only for integer denominators; they treat represented decisions as independent and are descriptive, not a test of platform differences.
limitations: At most three platforms are included; clustering platforms themselves is not a reliable typology.
Clusters are exploratory and do not establish causality.
Sanction indicators may co-occur and are not a single-class label.
Platform and violation-category labels are not clustering features.
